arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_fraud_dollars FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of all transactions labelled as fraud and converts the total from cents to dollars.
assumptions: Only transactions with a fraud label of is_fraud = 1 are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Amounts are summed as recorded, including any negative amounts, which are not treated as refunds.
